title: positional and named arguments cannot be mixed
purpose: Mixed argument styles never execute the call.

failure.justification: spec 8.10 forbids mixing but the grammar's arg_list accepts both forms and no stage is specified; the call must not complete.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: spec 8.10: positional and named arguments MUST NOT be mixed in one call.
